headline: OCBC to Allow Customers to Hold Malaysian Ringgit in Singapore Accounts
summary: OCBC announced customers can hold Malaysian Ringgit and earn interest in Singapore savings accounts starting October 23.
why: OCBC is a major Southeast Asian banking group, and multi-currency account features affect cross-border retail banking deposits.

impacts.name: OCBC
impacts.why: Expanding multi-currency capabilities can attract regional retail deposits.
